actions.text: Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation. Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably.
Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.

dimensions.assessment: Affects states, Indian tribes, nonprofit organizations, pool owners, and children nationwide targeted by drowning prevention and safety education.
dimensions.evidence: The term 'covered entity' means a State, an Indian Tribe, or a nonprofit organization.

dimensions.assessment: Funds state and nonprofit enforcement, inspections, and education campaigns aimed at preventing swimming pool entrapment and drownings.
dimensions.evidence: to educate pool owners, pool operators, and other members of the public about the prevention of drowning or entrapment of children

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes appropriations of $2,500,000 annually for the grant program and $2,500,000 annually for the education program for fiscal years 2026 through 2030.
dimensions.evidence: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Commission for each of the fiscal years 2026 through 2030 $2,500,000

dimensions.assessment: Amends grant criteria, expands eligible entities to nonprofits, establishes a Director of Drowning Prevention, and mandates Commission reporting.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall have a Director of Drowning Prevention to coordinate the swimming pool and spa safety and drowning prevention activities

dimensions.assessment: Reauthorizes grant and education programs for a five-year period from fiscal years 2026 through 2030.
dimensions.evidence: for each of the fiscal years 2026 through 2030 $2,500,000

missing_information: No information is missing regarding the fiscal authorizations or statutory changes specified in the source text.
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes the Virginia Graeme Baker Pool and Spa Safety Act, expanding grant eligibility to nonprofit organizations, funding safety programs, and establishing a Director of Drowning Prevention.
